novel_features.name: Similar advertisers
novel_features.description: Find advertisers with overlapping category, assets, and serviceType to a given advertiser.

novel_features.name: Click chain verifier
novel_features.description: Walk the /c/{impressionId} redirect chain, validate the URL scheme, and confirm the final landing matches the advertiser's clickUrl.

novel_features.name: Spec drift detector
novel_features.description: Re-fetch the published OpenAPI spec, compare schemas against what the live API actually returns, flag drift.

novel_features.name: Local demand mirror
novel_features.description: Fetch /demand and upsert into a local SQLite store so freshness, replay, watch, and trust-history queries work offline.

novel_features.name: Stale demand finder
novel_features.description: List demand entries the local mirror hasn't seen refreshed within the last N hours.

novel_features.name: Demand index health report
novel_features.description: Composite freshness + coverage + trust report across the locally synced demand index.

novel_features.name: Placement replay diff
novel_features.description: Re-issue a previously logged placement request to the live API and diff the new winner, scoutScore, decision, and ranking size against the original.

novel_features.name: Placement log tailer
novel_features.description: Poll the local placement log and stream new auction outcomes as a compact line or JSONL stream.

novel_features.name: Auction ranking explainer
novel_features.description: Decode the auction.ranking[] from a logged placement into a sorted human table (rank, service, score, bid, eligible, reason).

novel_features.name: Trust-score time series
novel_features.description: Render a sparkline + table of locally observed trust scores for a campaign or advertiser id.

novel_features.name: Campaign-by-wallet grouper
novel_features.description: Group locally mirrored campaigns by x402 payer wallet with per-wallet count, total balance, and category list.
